name: Josiah
summary: A king of Judah who began to reign at eight years old and did what was right in the eyes of the LORD. When the book of the law was found in the house of the LORD, he led the people back to the LORD and tore down the idols in the land.

key_moments.title: A Boy King
key_moments.description: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. He walked in all the way of David and did not turn aside.

key_moments.title: The Book of the Law Found
key_moments.description: While the house of the LORD was being repaired, Hilkiah the high priest found the book of the law. When it was read to Josiah, he tore his clothes and sent to ask of the LORD.

key_moments.title: Idols Torn Down
key_moments.description: Josiah read the book of the covenant to all the people, and they stood to the covenant. He tore down the idols and high places, even the altar Jeroboam had made at Bethel.

key_moments.title: A Great Passover
key_moments.description: Josiah commanded the people to keep the passover as it was written in the book of the covenant. No passover like it had been kept since the days of the judges.

key_moments.title: Killed at Megiddo
key_moments.description: Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up toward the river Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him. Pharaoh killed him at Megiddo, and his servants carried him dead to Jerusalem.
